- **The blocker is closed.** #20456 closed `completed` with PR #20474, merged 2026-09-28T17:42Z as `e967cbd24`.

- **objectui's end (objectui#11013) is not a precondition here.** The ruling words the appendix as "the persisted document is the parsed body once every round-trip key is **declared**", and declaring is the spec's end.
- **Scope unchanged.** Tier H, with the maintainer's APPROVED review. ⛔ No persistence code and no GUARD pins: those are stage (iv)'s, on #20051.

Serial constraints cleared: no open PR touches `docs/adr/0005-*` (all ten open PRs' file lists read at the round-open marker 5903866929); this lane has no other `pm:dispatched` card on this path; no same-day churn (last touch of the file `67add130`); #20051 (the parent, `pm:blocked`) holds stage (iv) and is not in flight.

Readings at 2026-09-30T04:15Z on `origin/main` `c9c182ed`: appendix (c) at `:337` still reads 「The persisted document is the **original** `request.item`, NOT `parsed.data`」; `export const VIEW_CONSOLE_ROUND_TRIP_KEYS` is at `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:6242`; the two pins that guard the verbatim save are still on `main` (`packages/objectql/src/protocol-meta.test.ts:586` 「preserves Studio-only auxiliary fields verbatim (not stripped)」, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.graft-folded-form-sections.test.ts:222` 「GUARD: Studio-only round-trip keys still survive the save」) ⇒ stage (iv) has not landed and the runtime still stores `request.item`. Blocker #20456 closed `completed` (PR #20474). The ruling 5856781584 was retrieved in this pass.
